html:
If you are traveling from Hanoi to Huu Nghi Border Gate and return to Hanoi, Vietlook Travel provides a safe, comfortable, and flexible private car service with an experienced driver, suitable for both tourists and business travelers.

Huu Nghi Border Gate is located in Lang Son Province, approximately one hundred seventy kilometers from Hanoi, with an average travel time of around three to three and a half hours each way, depending on traffic and border area conditions.

Flexible and Reliable Private Transfer Service

The Hanoi to Huu Nghi route is frequently used by travelers crossing the Vietnam and China border, business visitors, and guests handling immigration or commercial activities.

With our Hanoi to Huu Nghi Border Gate private car, you can:

  • Choose your preferred departure time from Hanoi

  • Travel directly without unnecessary stops

  • Request short breaks for rest, meals, or coffee

  • Adjust the schedule based on your border procedures

Our driver is familiar with the route and border area traffic, ensuring a smooth and punctual journey.

Comfortable Travel on Long Distance Roads

Compared to buses or shared transportation, a private car offers a more relaxed and private experience, especially for long distance travel.

Our vehicles provide:

  • Clean and spacious interiors

  • Strong air conditioning and safety seat belts

  • Quiet and comfortable seating for long hours

You can enjoy the scenery along the way and arrive at Huu Nghi Border Gate without stress or fatigue.

Round Trip Service from Hanoi to Huu Nghi

This service includes both directions, from Hanoi to Huu Nghi Border Gate and from Huu Nghi Border Gate back to Hanoi.

Our driver can wait at the border area based on your schedule or arrange pick up at a specified time and location, depending on your travel plan.

Professional Driver and Vehicle Options

Vietlook Travel offers:

  • Experienced drivers familiar with long distance routes

  • Polite, punctual, and helpful service

  • Sedan cars, sport utility vehicles, minivans, and luxury vehicles

  • Assistance with luggage at pick up and drop off points

A baby seat is available free of charge upon request.

Why Choose Vietlook Travel?

  • Door to door private transfer service

  • Fixed and transparent pricing with no hidden costs

  • Flexible pick up time based on your schedule

  • Reliable vehicles with professional drivers

  • Customer support available at all times

For booking and support, please contact us via: Hotline: (+84) 98.339.3588 or (+84) 98.339.3488
